title: Xia
subtitle: Stockline assistant
description: Ask how Stockline works, or about your orders. Xia reads your orders (read-only); it can't act for you.
welcomeBody: I can explain how orders, redistribution, the ERP and the dashboard work.

suggestions.statuses: What do the order statuses mean?
suggestions.importOrder: How do I import an order?
suggestions.erpRetry: How do I retry an order the ERP rejected?
suggestions.dashboard: What do the dashboard indicators mean?
suggestions.resetPassword: How do I reset a user's password?

input.label: Your question
input.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line

slow: The first answer can take a minute while the model loads.

quota.left: {remaining, plural, one {# question left} other {# questions left}} of {limit}

errors.notConfigured: The assistant isn't set up on this server.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again to keep asking.
errors.quotaExhausted: You've used all your questions for now. They renew in {wait}.
errors.quotaExhaustedShort: You've used all your questions for now. They renew automatically.
errors.busy: Xia is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.noAccess: Your account can't use the assistant yet. Ask an administrator.
errors.invalid: That question couldn't be sent. Try rewording it.
errors.unavailable: Xia isn't responding right now. Try again later.

noAnswerText: I couldn't find that in the documentation. Try rephrasing it, or ask about orders, redistribution, the ERP or the dashboard.
